SELECT i.DC_ID, i.MATERIAL_ID, i.SNAPSHOT_DT, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, i.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV i WHERE i.SNAPSHOT_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) FROM dbo.DC_INV) AND (i.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003') OR i.MATERIAL_ID LIKE 'FG-30%') ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, COUNT(*) n, SUM(UNITS) units, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003') AND SHIP_DT>='2026-07-01' GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID ORDER BY 2,1,3
SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND SNAPSHOT_DT>='2026-07-01' ORDER BY 2,3
SELECT * FROM dbo.WHSLR

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, SUM(UNITS) units_13wk, COUNT(DISTINCT DATEADD(day, -((DATEPART(weekday,SHIP_DT)+5)%7), SHIP_DT)) wks FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003') AND SHIP_DT> DATEADD(week,-13,'2026-09-30') GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID ORDER BY 2,1,3
SELECT ACCT_TYP, COUNT(*) n, MIN(ACCOUNT_ID), MAX(ACCOUNT_NM) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT GROUP BY 1
SELECT MAX(SHIP_DT) mx, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP

SELECT DATEADD(day, 7*CEILING(DATEDIFF(day,'2026-09-25',SHIP_DT)/7.0), '2026-09-25') wk_end, MATERIAL_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID='W-01' THEN UNITS END) w01, SUM(CASE WHEN WHSLR_ID='W-02' THEN UNITS END) w02 FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT>'2026-06-26' GROUP BY DATEADD(day, 7*CEILING(DATEDIFF(day,'2026-09-25',SHIP_DT)/7.0), '2026-09-25'), MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID, SUM(UNITS) units_13wk FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, WHSLR_ID ORDER BY 2,1,3

SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, comment FROM PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE column_name ILIKE ANY ('%WAC%','%PRICE%','%COST%','%AMT%') OR comment ILIKE ANY ('%restrict%','%supply%','%allocation%','%not be used%') ORDER BY 1,2
